repos_data.description: Persistent Project Context for Claude — IANA-registered .faf format · Core 14 MCP tools (30 with FAF_TOOLS=all) + 2 prompts · MCP Registry #2759

MCP server that checks whether a website is set up for AI the way its owner intends: can GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and 50+ other AI crawlers read it, and what does its access policy allow? Generates llms.txt, an AI-crawler robots.txt and JSON-LD, reads your Answer Analysis, and checks whether a page permits an AI use.
